propositions: Bridge mapped-keys and legacy_default may be syntactically valid but nonexistent or bot-invisible in Jira, with no on-demand operator diagnostic outside a full reconcile pass.
Add an opt-in --live-visibility flag to `rebar bridge fsck` that performs a live read-only visibility check by calling the shared `check_mapped_project_visibility` helper from access_check.py.

When JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, and JIRA_API_TOKEN credentials are absent or incomplete and no probe is injected, the fsck step gracefully skips with status='skipped' and reason='missing_credentials', without calling the probe and without altering exit code.

The visibility advisory is rendered to stderr in both text and JSON output modes, and is NOT added to the stdout JSON schema to preserve the existing {unknown_event_types, binding_drift, store_integrity} contract.
Core `rebar doctor` must remain Jira-free with no reconciler or [agents] imports reachable from _commands/doctor.py, keeping the live visibility check isolated to the bridge fsck surface.
